papers.title_en: How Well Do Prior-Data Fitted Networks Amortize Bayesian Inference?
papers.authors: Manuel Hülskamp, Julius Kobialka, Emanuel Sommer, Thomas Nagler, David Rügamer
papers.evidence: 将PFN部署误差分解为先验、上下文与摊销误差
papers.tldr: PFN通过合成先验近似贝叶斯后验预测分布，但其近似质量缺乏系统评估。作者从经验风险最小化视角将部署误差分解为先验、上下文与摊销误差，并以真实先验下的参考PPD度量摊销误差。结果显示PFN总体能很好恢复目标PPD，但在先验预训练分布中的稀有情形仍残留摊销误差，且增大模型规模也难以消除，导致独立预训练的PFN之间不一致。进一步研究表明贝叶斯模型平均可降低该不确定性并提升预测，甚至适用于完整规模TabICLv2。
papers.abstract_en: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are trained to approximate the Bayesian posterior predictive distribution (PPD) of a synthetic prior, yet results about the approximation quality are surprisingly thin. Taking an empirical risk minimization perspective, we decompose the deployment error of PFNs into prior, context, and amortization error, and measure the latter against a reference PPD under a realistic prior. Results show that PFNs generally recover the targeted PPD very well. Nevertheless, we find that parts of the residual amortization error persist, especially in \textit{rare} settings under the prior pretraining distribution, even when scaling the model size, which manifests in disagreement between independently pretrained PFNs and leaves uncertainty about the predictor at inference time. As a remedy, we study multiple types of Bayesian model averages and find that these can consistently reduce this uncertainty and improve predictions up to full-size TabICLv2 models.

papers.title_en: Characterizing the Separability Gap in Prior-Data Fitted Networks
papers.authors: Julius Kobialka, Manuel Hülskamp, Thomas Nagler, David Rügamer
papers.evidence: 直接分析先验数据拟合网络及其贝叶斯后验预测预训练
papers.tldr: PFN以模拟数据预训练近似贝叶斯后验预测，但标准理论假设任务先验可分离，即特征分布与标签机制独立。作者证明常见PFN先验在简单设定下也不可分离，预训练实际用带标签上下文和查询特征共同更新后验。他们刻画其与仅用上下文后验的差异：后验集中时差异消失，误设下不可分离先验可能牺牲条件标签拟合换取更好特征拟合。该效应影响特征归因、贝叶斯优化与鞅检验，也让PFN可利用额外无标签观测；SemiTabICL在匹配监督基线上提升准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are transformers pretrained on simulated datasets to approximate Bayesian posterior predictive distributions. Standard PFN theory assumes a separable task prior, under which the feature distribution and the mechanism generating labels from features are independent. We show that common PFN priors are non-separable, even in simple settings. Consequently, standard pretraining targets a predictive distribution based on a task posterior updated using both the labeled context and the query features. We characterize its difference from the predictive based on the context posterior alone and show that this difference vanishes under posterior concentration. Under misspecification (i.e., when the true joint distribution lies outside the prior's support), however, prior non-separability can favor better feature fit at the expense of conditional label fit. We illustrate the consequences for feature attribution, Bayesian optimization, and martingale checks of Bayesian behavior. The same dependence also enables PFNs to learn from additional unlabeled observations. We demonstrate this with SemiTabICL, a PFN explicitly pretrained to use these observations, which improves accuracy over a matched supervised baseline. Our findings highlight the need for explicit rules on unlabeled data use in PFN evaluation and establish the dependence between feature and label distributions as a consequential prior design choice.

papers.title_en: Debiased Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Amortized Bayesian Semi-Parametric Inference
papers.authors: Valentyn Melnychuk, Emil Javurek, Stefan Feuerriegel
papers.evidence: 去偏PFN用于摊销贝叶斯半参数推断的理论基础
papers.tldr: PFN 已用于端到端摊销贝叶斯推断，但其在半参数目标（如缺失下均值、因果效应）中的统计行为尚不清楚。本文建立去偏 PFN 的理论基础，揭示理想 PFN 的后验收缩率会受冗余 nuisance 函数收缩率拖累。作者基于有效影响函数提出标签修正与先验修正两种去偏策略。结果表明去偏 PFN 的收缩率可渐近匹配传统频率学派偏差修正估计量，建立摊销贝叶斯与半参数效率理论的联系，并给出局部与全局最优性保证。
papers.abstract_en: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have recently gained popularity as an end-to-end approach to amortized Bayesian inference. Yet, their statistical behavior for semi-parametric targets, such as means under missingness or causal effects, remains poorly understood. In this work, we develop theoretical foundations for debiased PFNs to perform inference on finite-dimensional targets in general semi-parametric settings. First, we show that, despite being Bayes-optimal with respect to the target, an idealized PFN can exhibit a posterior concentration rate that implicitly depends on the concentration rates of (latent) nuisance functions and can become slower as the prior becomes more diverse. Then, to speed up the target posterior concentration rates, we introduce two generic debiasing strategies based on efficient influence functions: (i) a label correction and (ii) a prior correction. Finally, we show that the debiased PFNs (i) & (ii) possess concentration rates that asymptotically match a convergence rate given by traditional frequentist bias-corrected estimators. In this way, we establish a novel connection between amortized Bayesian inference with PFNs and frequentist semi-parametric efficiency theory. Under additional assumptions, this allows us to guarantee local and global optimality of PFN-based estimators (namely, the Bernstein-von Mises property and minimax optimality, respectively). Therefore, our work provides guidelines for designing debiased PFNs for semi-parametric inference with principled and provable asymptotic guarantees.

papers.title_en: LinearPFN: Amortized Variable Selection for Linear Models with Interactions
papers.authors: Louis Schiekiera, Max Zimmer, Christophe Roux, Manuel Arnold, Sebastian Pokutta, Fritz Günther
papers.evidence: 用先验数据拟合的 Transformer 网络摊销 spike-and-slab 贝叶斯变量选择推断
papers.tldr: Spike-and-slab变量选择的后验随候选效应数指数增长，超出枚举范围后只能逐数据集跑MCMC近似，成本高且可能不收敛。LinearPFN用一次性预训练的transformer摊销含主效应与两两交互线性模型的后验推断，单次前向即输出后验包含概率、后验均值系数与后验预测分布。在可枚举的小规模问题上其输出与精确后验吻合，在真实社科预测矩阵上选择AUC与F1优于五个经典基线。这使贝叶斯变量选择无需逐数据集拟合。
papers.abstract_en: Spike-and-slab regression is a standard Bayesian formulation of variable selection: it returns a posterior distribution over which candidate effects are active rather than a single selected subset, so that every candidate effect carries an inclusion probability. Its cost grows exponentially with the number of candidate effects, so the posterior can be enumerated exactly only when the number of predictors is small. Beyond that reach, the posterior has to be approximated, typically by Markov chain Monte Carlo over the model space, which requires a fresh run for every dataset and, within a fixed budget of steps, may fail to converge. We present LinearPFN, a prior-data fitted transformer network that amortizes spike-and-slab inference for linear models with main effects and pairwise interactions. The network is pretrained once on synthetic datasets, drawn from an explicitly specified prior, and a single forward pass over a new dataset returns posterior inclusion probabilities, posterior-mean coefficients and posterior predictive distributions with no per-dataset fitting. The prior is conjugate by design, so that the posterior for each fixed set of active effects has a closed form, and wherever the exact posterior is still computable by enumeration we verify the network's outputs against it. On real predictor matrices from published social-science datasets, with outcomes drawn from the prior so that the true active set is known, LinearPFN attains a higher per-dataset selection AUC and a higher F1 under the median probability model rule than five classical baselines. The lead holds when the coefficients, the interactions or the noise depart from the prior. Code: https://github.com/schiekiera/LinearPFN. Trained model: https://huggingface.co/schiekiera/LinearPFN.

papers.title_en: Adapting prior-data fitted networks for tabular anomaly detection
papers.authors: Maximilian Bershtman, Niv Cohen
papers.evidence: 将TabPFN等先验数据拟合网络表示适配于表格异常检测
papers.tldr: 表格异常检测长期缺乏强深度表示，PFN 的出现提供了新可能，但部署前没有异常标签，且定义正常行为的参考集本身可能混入异常。作者先使用冻结的 TabPFN 特征，以特征空间最近邻距离给样本打分，并筛选合适层与特征提取流程，形成无需微调的 ZEN；随后利用参考集微调模型，使特征更好区分正常与异常，得到 FOCUS。在 ADBench 上，ZEN 的平均 AUROC 高于所有基线，FOCUS 进一步提升。该工作表明 PFN 表示可有效迁移到表格异常检测，并能跨不同 PFN 模型泛化。
papers.abstract_en: While deep features have transformed anomaly detection in images and video, their impact on tabular data has been less substantial, partly due to the limited availability of strong deep representations. Recently, prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have emerged as a promising source of such representations for tabular data. In this work, we investigate how PFN representations can be adapted and leveraged for anomaly detection. The question is harder than it looks. No anomalies are available before deploy- ment, so model parameters cannot be tuned with supervision, and the reference set that defines normal behavior may itself contain the very anomalies it is supposed to reveal. We begin our study using frozen TabPFN features. Scoring each sam- ple by its distance to its nearest neighbors in feature space already gives strong results. We identify which layers to use and a feature-extraction procedure suited to the task. Next, to further improve performance, we use the reference set to fine- tune the model, so that the resulting features better separate normal samples from anomalies. On the ADBench benchmark, our fine-tuning free approach (ZEN) reaches a higher mean AUROC than every baseline, and our fine-tuned method (FOCUS) improves on it further. Our approach also generalizes across PFN models.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Mean Estimation by In-Context Learning: A Gradient-Flow Analysis
papers.authors: Martin Eppert, Krishna Balasubramanian, Subhro Ghosh, Jason Klusowski, Yan Shuo Tan
papers.evidence: 解释TabPFN等先验拟合网络通过上下文学习获得的统计自适应性
papers.tldr: PFN已具统计自适应性，但其上下文习得机制尚不清楚。论文在隐藏分布族的位置估计中，把标量softmax attention视为经验累积量生成函数导数，构造均值与mid-range插值，并以softmax专家混合或GLU组合专家。梯度流分析证明，足够预训练下高斯任务渐近有效、均匀任务近minimax、混合任务阶最优，且可泛化到新位置和更长上下文。风险分解揭示softmax门控自带归一化与平移等变，GLU需分阶段学习，实验验证专家特化。
papers.abstract_en: Prior Fitted Networks (PFNs) such as TabPFN now rival established statistical procedures across prediction and estimation tasks. A natural explanation is that PFNs have the property of statistical adaptivity, that is, they perform nearly as well as a method tailored to the true data-generating model for a heterogeneous set of models, while not being told which model the data comes from. We study how such adaptivity is learned in a controlled location-estimation problem. Each task is an unlabeled sample whose family is hidden: Gaussian data call for averaging, with error of order $n^{-1}$, whereas uniform data are best estimated from their extremes, at the faster rate $n^{-2}$. We also provide the example of a symmetric Gaussian mixture, for which a rate of $σ^2_n/n$ can be attained. On scalar inputs, softmax attention computes the derivative of the empirical cumulant-generating function. A single primitive therefore both supplies features that distinguish the families and forms estimators interpolating between the sample mean and the mid-range. We combine attention experts through either a softmax mixture of experts or a gated linear unit (GLU), and analyze stagewise gradient flow. With $\widetildeΩ(n^{1+ε})$ pretraining tasks, the learned estimator is asymptotically efficient on Gaussian tasks, within a factor $n^ε$ of the minimax rate on uniform tasks, and order-optimal on mixtures in a shrinking-variance regime. These guarantees extend to new locations and longer contexts. A risk decomposition separates expert error, routing error and normalization error, which clarifies the architectural contrast. Softmax gating enforces normalization and exact translation equivariance, whereas the GLU must learn it: its dynamics separate into fast bias removal followed by slow expert selection. End-to-end experiments recover the predicted specialization.

papers.title_en: Continual Learning without Continual Training
papers.authors: Nikita Narayanan, Ritham Majumdarr, Sonali Parbhoo
papers.evidence: 元训练后冻结的先验数据拟合网络在潜概念空间做上下文贝叶斯推断以实现持续适应
papers.tldr: 持续学习通常依赖持续优化，通过正则、回放或参数扩展防止遗忘，但更新仍可能覆盖旧知识。作者提出以持续推理替代持续训练：元训练后冻结的 PFN 模型，仅通过扩展上下文证据集适配新类与新域。其 Latent Concept PFN 在潜在概念空间做上下文贝叶斯推断，不更新参数，统一处理无任务标识的域/类增量学习。实验显示具有竞争力的持续学习性能，并获得可解释潜在概念。
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new domains and new classes while retaining prior knowledge. Many existing methods rely on continued optimization, using regularization, replay, or parameter expansion to prevent new updates from overwriting previously learned knowledge. Instead, we propose replacing continual training with continual inference: a PFN-based model that is meta-trained, and then frozen, adapting to new classes only by extending an in-context evidence set. Our model, Latent Concept PFN, performs in-context Bayesian inference over a latent concept space that captures semantic structure shared across domains and classes. As each new domain or class arrives, exemplars are added to the memory; adaptation reflects updated posterior beliefs over latent concepts rather than gradient updates. No parameters are changed, reducing forgetting. The same method handles both domain and class incremental continual learning without task identity. Concept annotations are only used during meta-training, acting as a soft anchor on the latent space rather than a fixed bottleneck. Unlike fixed-vocabulary concept methods, the model also handles noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete annotations by combining concept labels with raw input evidence to discover distinctions beyond the predefined concept set. Experiments on class and domain incremental learning datasets demonstrate competitive continual learning performance while learning interpretable latent concepts.

papers.title_en: GIST: Generator-state-Informed Supervision for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Zhangyang Peng, Jingze Shi, Tongyi Zhang, Yuyu Luo
papers.evidence: 利用生成器中间状态改进先验数据拟合表格基础模型的预训练监督
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型预训练常以采样得到的硬查询标签进行监督，带来可避免的采样波动。GIST利用生成器中间状态所蕴含的标签不确定性，对条件标签分布上的查询损失做平均，并联合设计任务生成与查询监督，通过熵校准编码获得可处理且输入一致的目标。在匹配预训练计划下，GIST在TabArena和TALENT上提升三种架构的平均排名，且不改变架构或推理；对硬标签对照的配对数据集比较胜率达62.1%。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) based on prior-data fitted networks typically use sampled hard query labels, leaving avoidable sampling variability in pretraining. A key observation is that intermediate generator states can reveal label uncertainty beyond a sampled outcome. We propose Generator-state-Informed Supervision for TFMs (GIST), which uses these states to average query losses over conditional label distributions. GIST jointly designs task generation and query supervision, using entropy-calibrated encodings to obtain tractable, input-consistent targets on supported label-dependent branches. We show that this averaging preserves the population objective and yields no larger gradient covariance at fixed parameters within each generating distribution. Under matched pretraining schedules, GIST improves mean rank across three architectures on both TabArena and TALENT without changing architecture or inference. Across these benchmarks and architectures, GIST wins 62.1% of paired dataset-level comparisons against the corresponding hard-label controls.

papers.title_en: When Does Depth Help? Understanding Layerwise Inference in Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Wenwen Gong, Haotian Gu, Zhen Yang, Jiaying Ma, Hanqing Zhang, Zhongshen Wang, Jingjun Wang, Shouyi Xu, Wei Wang
papers.evidence: 对TabPFN-3全部24个上下文学习层进行逐层分析
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型早期层预测强且层间计算重叠，但后期层是否对所有输入冗余不明。作者分析TabPFN-3全部24个上下文学习层、272个分类数据集，结合表示几何、预测轨迹、截断和结构干预，并对照四个TFM。发现扩张-压缩轨迹，后期维度收缩越强类原型分离提升越大；类别稳定后表示仍变化，模糊查询浅层到后期增益更大，重复或打乱层序平均降性能。这区分预测可达性、类别稳定性和继续计算收益，支持按输入评估深度冗余。
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on small to medium-sized tabular prediction tasks while processing diverse inputs through a shared stack of layers. Recent layerwise analyses identify strong predictive performance in early TFM representations and substantial overlap in computation across layers. However, early predictive accessibility alone does not establish whether later layers are dispensable for every input, and aggregate accuracy can obscure which inputs benefit from additional computation. We study all 24 in-context-learning layers of TabPFN-3 across 272 classification datasets, combining representation geometry, prediction trajectories, truncation, and structural interventions, while also examining related representation dynamics in four additional TFMs. We uncover a pronounced expansion-compression trajectory, with stronger late dimensional contraction associated with larger increases in class-prototype separation. A targeted analysis of early-stabilizing samples shows that substantial representational changes persist after predicted classes stabilize, while locally ambiguous queries obtain larger accuracy gains from shallow to late layers than well-separated queries. Repeating a single pretrained block or perturbing layer order reduces predictive performance on average, constraining simple post-hoc substitutions in the frozen model. These findings distinguish predictive accessibility, class stability, and the benefits of continuing computation, supporting an input-dependent assessment of depthwise redundancy in TFMs.

papers.title_en: SelectPFN: Amortized Bayesian Variable Selection for Sparse Nonlinear Regression with Prior-Data Fitted Networks
papers.authors: Bin Luo
papers.evidence: 在合成任务上预训练的PFN单次前向完成摊销贝叶斯变量选择
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型虽能单次前向预测，却无法说明预测依赖哪些输入。SelectPFN将贝叶斯变量选择与稀疏非线性回归预测联合建模，一次前向输出各变量后验纳入概率，并仅用采样子集预测。在p达500的分布外非线性任务上，其PR-AUC较lasso、BART、DART、LassoNet和组惩罚稀疏网络提升0.23–0.28，误发现比例约0.07、每数据集约0.04秒。该工作还给出摊销选择理论及有限样本FDR控制，为可解释、可控错误率的表格基础模型提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models based on prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) predict on a new data set in a single forward pass, but they cannot report which inputs their predictions depend on. We propose SelectPFN, a PFN that performs Bayesian variable selection and prediction jointly for sparse nonlinear regression. In one forward pass it returns posterior inclusion probabilities for every variable, and its predictions are computed from sampled subsets only, so excluded variables provably cannot affect them; we show this is exactly what the Bayesian model prescribes. The network is pretrained once on synthetic tasks from a meta-prior built around a group spike-and-slab sparse-input neural network. Column-permutation equivariance combined with random interleaving of original and knockoff columns yields knockoff statistics with exact finite-sample false discovery rate control, even when the meta-prior is wrong. We develop theory for amortized selection: a Bayes-regret bound for the amortized median probability model, a characterization showing that the information needed to detect a variable grows like $(2/λ)\log(1/ω)$ in the prior weight $ω$ of structures that can use it, where $λ\le1$ is an efficiency, and a negative result showing that average-case training does not transfer to frequentist guarantees at a fixed truth. On out-of-prior nonlinear designs with p up to 500, SelectPFN improves the area under the precision-recall curve by 0.23-0.28 over the lasso, BART, DART, LassoNet and a group-penalized sparse neural network, at a false discovery proportion of about 0.07 and 0.04 seconds per data set. The advantage persists on real covariate matrices, and, as the theory predicts, detection of interaction-only variables rises monotonically with their prior weight.

papers.title_en: Path to Prior-Data Fitted Relational Models via Learned Latent Multi-table Representations
papers.authors: Mohammad Sadeq Abolhasani, Viswanath Ganapathy
papers.evidence: 在大量合成关系数据库上对图关系模型进行PFN式预训练
papers.tldr: 针对图式关系基础模型是否也能受益于先验数据拟合式合成预训练尚不清楚的问题，本文在合成关系数据库上预训练基于消息传递的Griffin，并将其潜在多表表示交给冻结的上下文预测器。在16个真实关系分类任务上，先模式引导后模式无关的纯合成课程取得最强冻结上下文性能。该结果优于仅真实数据预训练和无序单阶段混合，且接在真实数据预训练后得到整体最佳编码器，为PFN式合成预训练迁移到图式关系模型提供初步证据。
papers.abstract_en: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) show that pretraining on large populations of synthetic tasks can enable generalization to unseen datasets with little or no downstream fine-tuning. This paradigm is effective for transformer-based tabular and relational foundation models such as RDB-PFN, but remains largely unexplored for graph-based relational models built on message passing. We pretrain the graph-based relational foundation model Griffin on large collections of synthetic relational databases and ask whether curriculum learning, which benefits transformer-based relational learners, also improves message-passing representations. Rather than fine-tune on downstream tasks, we use the pretrained encoder as a general-purpose relational representation learner and pass its latent representations to a frozen in-context predictor (\ticl{}); no component is trained on the target task. On 16 real-world relational classification tasks, evaluated over five seeds against raw-feature and untrained-encoder baselines, a purely synthetic curriculum that begins with schema-guided data and continues with schema-agnostic data gives the strongest frozen in-context performance\rev{, outperforming real-data-only pretraining and every unordered single-stage mixture of the corpora; when appended after real-data pretraining, it yields the best encoders overall}. These results provide initial evidence that PFN-style synthetic pretraining transfers to graph-based relational foundation models.

papers.title_en: Prior-Data Fitted Networks for In-Context Off-Policy Evaluation
papers.authors: Shuguang Yu, Ting Li, Fan Zhou
papers.evidence: 在合成OPE任务先验上预训练PFN以实现摊销策略价值预测
papers.tldr: 离线策略评估用于部署前评估决策策略，但当行为策略数据有限、目标策略偏向数据中罕见的状态动作时，准确估计期望回报仍然困难。InCOPE 构建覆盖马尔可夫决策过程及行为-目标策略对的合成 OPE 任务先验，生成行为数据集与精确目标策略价值用于预训练。面对新的表格型决策问题，预训练网络无需任务特定参数更新，仅将行为策略数据、目标策略和已知任务设定作为上下文，即可预测策略期望回报。在四个表格域及半合成临床场景上的实验表明，该方法能有效进行策略价值估计，为有限数据下的离线评估提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) is essential for assessing decision policies before deployment when online experimentation is costly or unsafe. Accurate estimation remains difficult when behavior-policy data are limited and the target policy favors states and actions rarely observed in those data. We propose InCOPE, a prior-data fitted network that learns a shared policy-value prediction rule across synthetic OPE tasks. We construct an OPE task prior over Markov decision processes and behavior-target policy pairs, generating behavior-policy datasets and exact target-policy values for pretraining. For a new tabular decision problem, the pretrained network uses the behavior-policy dataset, target policy, and known task settings as context to predict the policy's expected return without task-specific parameter updates. Experiments across four tabular domains, including a semi-synthetic clinical setting, demonstrate InCOPE's effectiveness for policy-value estimation.

papers.title_en: GAS-PFN: Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Zero-Shot Traffic Forecasting
papers.authors: Joseph Natter, Long Vu, Yifan Zhang, Bobin Deng, Kun Suo, Rui Wu
papers.evidence: 从含图结构的合成任务先验中学习上下文推理的PFN
papers.tldr: 交通预测需同时刻画时间动态与路网拓扑，但现有图模型通常绑定特定数据集和传感器图，迁移部署成本高。GAS-PFN将采样路网拓扑经随机游走扩散注入合成任务先验，并用共享Transformer的两次掩码条件推理分别建模单传感器时序与邻域时空交互。在六个基准的90分钟预测中，其MSE较TimePFN平均降低34.0%，较四个通用零样本预测器平均降低27.7%。这表明对齐PFN先验与推理结构可提升零样本交通预测。
papers.abstract_en: Traffic forecasting requires modeling complex temporal dynamics and the spatial dependencies imposed by road topology. Supervised graph-based models achieve strong performance, but are often trained for a particular dataset and sensor graph, making deployment to new or evolving networks costly. Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) offer a zero-shot alternative by learning in-context inference from synthetic task priors, which provide an explicit mechanism for encoding domain-specific assumptions. Existing forecasting PFNs, however, do not explicitly represent the graph-structured dependencies governing traffic dynamics. To combine graph-aware traffic modeling with zero-shot adaptation, we introduce the Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Network (GAS-PFN). GAS-PFN incorporates sampled road topology into its synthetic task prior through random-walk diffusion, teaching the model to learn graph-coupled dynamics during pretraining. Its co-designed inference architecture uses two mask-conditioned passes through a shared Transformer backbone to separately model sensor-specific temporal dynamics and spatiotemporal interactions among neighboring sensors before integrating their representations for prediction. This design enables GAS-PFN to use target-network structure and context without parameter updates. Across six benchmarks at the 90-minute horizon, GAS-PFN reduces MSE by 34.0% on average relative to TimePFN, its closest PFN-based predecessor. It also reduces MSE by 27.7% on average relative to four recent industry-developed general-purpose zero-shot forecasters. In this comparison, all models receive 90 minutes of contiguous recent history, and any additional context is drawn from each dataset's chronological training split. These results indicate that aligning PFN priors and inference architectures with graph structure improves in-context learning for zero-shot traffic forecasting.

papers.title_en: Learning a Prior-Data Fitted Network for Graph Foundation Models via Structural Causal Model Priors
papers.authors: Ziwei Zhang, Tianyin Liao, Chunyu Hu, Ge Lan, Nuo Xu, Yi Huang, Qingyun Sun, Xingxuan Zhang, Peng Cui, Jianxin Li
papers.evidence: 用结构因果模型先验生成的合成图数据训练图先验数据拟合网络
papers.tldr: 图基础模型（GFM）在跨图、跨域迁移上面临预训练规模有限、过度依赖LLM文本对齐等问题。本文提出GSCM-PFN，用联合建模节点与拓扑结构的结构因果模型先验生成合成图，并设计特征置换不变的双路径图网络进行预训练。在23个真实基准上，它不依赖真实图数据预训练即超越传统GFM与PFN类GFM。
papers.abstract_en: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for learning transferable representations across different graphs and domains. However, existing GFMs face notable limitations, including limited pre-training scale or reliance on aligning with textual information in Large Language Models (LLMs). To overcome these limitations, recent studies have drawn inspiration from prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which learn from large synthetic datasets and support multi-domain prediction backed by causal learning. However, existing graph PFNs encounter severe difficulties in modeling causal relationships within and across node and edge sets, generating diverse graph structures, and designing suitable architectures that can learn from complex synthetic datasets. To address these challenges, we propose **GSCM-PFN** (Graph SCM-based Prior-Data Fitted Network), a graph PFN pre-trained on synthetic data generated from an SCM-based prior that jointly models nodes and graph topology. Specifically, we (1) design a joint feature-edge-label structural causal model (SCM) to guide synthetic graph generation and capture causal relationships within and across node and edge sets; (2) introduce prior-guided node-edge dependency modeling to instantiate diverse graph generation strategies, and prove that our SCM-based generation prior is more expressive than existing priors; and (3) propose a feature-permutation-invariant dual-path graph network with theoretical guarantees for learning from diverse synthetic graphs. Experiments on 23 real-world benchmarks show that GSCM-PFN outperforms both conventional GFMs and PFN-based GFMs, without utilizing real-world graph data for pre-training. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GSCM-PFN-A3A3/

papers.title_en: Rethinking Tabular Foundation Models On Data Streams
papers.authors: Nilesh Verma, Daniel Nowak-Assis, Afonso Lourenço, Albert Bifet, Bernhard Pfahringer, Maroua Bahri, Nick Jin Sean Lim
papers.evidence: 表格基础模型在数据流上的上下文内学习适应
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型（TFM）在静态表格基准上表现突出，但其在持续演化数据流中的表现尚缺系统认识。本文围绕记忆管理、计算开销、概念漂移与标签延迟，系统评估TFM的上下文更新式流学习。实验发现TFM预测精度最高，仅保留最新样本即可媲美现有记忆管理方法，且漂移后恢复更快、标签延迟下精度最高。但每次预测几乎重复编码上下文带来高服务成本，作者由此指出架构效率是上下文式流学习的关键方向。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) outperform established machine learning models on tabular benchmarks through in-context learning. Building on this success, interest is growing in applying them to data streams, where data arrive continuously and evolve over time. On a stream, a TFM adapts by updating its context rather than its parameters, so its accuracy and cost depend on which examples it keeps and how often it rebuilds its context. We therefore present a systematic study of TFMs on data streams, covering memory management, computational cost, and stream-specific challenges such as concept drift and delayed labels. We find that TFMs achieve the highest predictive performance and that simply retaining the most recent examples is as effective as existing memory management techniques. They also recover faster than streaming learners after drift and keep the highest accuracy under label delay. This accuracy, however, comes at a high serving cost, since a nearly unchanged context is re-encoded at every prediction. These results point to architectural efficiency as the way forward for in-context stream learning.

papers.title_en: Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning
papers.authors: Yoel Zeldes
papers.evidence: 研究表格基础模型的上下文学习，并用合成数据上的激活对齐缩减上下文规模
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型依赖完整上下文进行上下文学习，但每次预测都处理全部训练样本，推理成本高；缩减上下文虽提速却明显掉点。作者提出激活对齐：用合成无标签数据训练轻量线性变换，把部分上下文“学生”的中间激活映射到全上下文“教师”。在TabArena的38个分类数据集及TabPFN-3、TabFM上，各上下文预算均获显著提升，低数据下恢复近半教师优势。该方法无需GPU、秒至分钟收敛，以低开销兼顾紧凑上下文速度与接近全上下文的性能。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.

papers.title_en: Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Policies with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yuta Kobayashi, Divyam Madaan, Shalmali Joshi
papers.evidence: 用PFN作为即用模型输出表格数据的后验预测分布
papers.tldr: 主动特征获取需从有限离线数据中学习和评估策略。论文发现，离线数据覆盖不均衡时，PFN输出的总预测熵奖励会混入认知不确定性，偏向惩罚稀疏特征。为此改用后验期望的偶然熵作为采集目标，以分离两类不确定性。合成与真实数据实验显示，该法降低价值估计偏差、置信区间覆盖良好，并能改善下游策略选择。
papers.abstract_en: Active feature acquisition learns policies that sequentially acquire features to maximize information about a target variable. We study how to learn and evaluate such policies from finite offline data using prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which are off-the-shelf models that output posterior predictive distributions without task-specific training. We show that under the imbalanced coverage of offline data, using total predictive entropy as a reward creates an epistemic bias that penalizes acquiring sparsely observed features. Specifically, this reward conflates epistemic uncertainty (arising from lack of offline data) with aleatoric uncertainty (arising from uninformative features). To address this, we target the posterior expected (aleatoric) entropy instead of the total predictive entropy output by a PFN for evaluating feature acquisitions. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently reduces value estimation bias and yields credible intervals with strong empirical coverage, which can translate to improved downstream policy selection.

papers.title_en: Thinking in Depth: Retrospective Inference for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Hao-Run Cai, Si-Yang Liu, Zi-Jian Cheng, Kun-Yang Yu, Jin-Hao Sheng, Guo Yu, Chonghan Liu, Zhi Zhou, Jun-Peng Jiang, Lan-Zhe Guo, Han-Jia Ye
papers.evidence: 执行上下文内表格预测的表格基础模型
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型通常依赖堆叠 Transformer 做上下文预测，但查询的预测修正在不同深度上分布不均，常集中在后层。Retro 引入回顾式推理，让后层显式重访并重组前层中间表示，并用注意力残差自适应加权不同深度贡献、查询条件门控注意力逐维调制上下文更新。分析显示该机制把预测修正提前并分散到更多层，形成多视角修正；在 TabArena、TALENT、RelArena 上进入前三并位于 Pareto 前沿。这表明直接复用中间表示是更充分利用模型深度的实用途径。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained across diverse tabular tasks and make predictions on a new table at inference time using its labeled examples as context. Most recent TFMs perform such in-context prediction with stacked Transformer layers, repeatedly transforming how examples are represented and compared. By tracing individual queries through several strong TFMs, we find that predictive refinement is highly uneven across depth and is often concentrated in later layers. This uneven refinement motivates us to reconsider how intermediate representations are constructed and reused throughout the network. We introduce Retro, a tabular foundation model based on retrospective inference, where later stages can explicitly revisit and recombine intermediate information produced earlier in the network. Retro organizes this process around two complementary operations: which intermediate information to revisit, and how the resulting contextual update should be shaped for each query. Attention Residuals address the former by adaptively reweighting contributions from different depths, while query-conditioned Gated Attention addresses the latter by modulating the attention output element-wise across representation dimensions. Our analysis shows that Retro shifts predictive refinement earlier and more broadly across depth, with different stages revising different subsets of queries in a pattern suggestive of multi-view refinement. Across TabArena, TALENT, and RelArena, Retro ranks among the top three and lies on the Pareto frontier. These results indicate that directly reusing intermediate representations provides a practical way to better exploit depth in TFMs.

papers.title_en: MotherTree: Meta-learning on synthetic data improves decision tree training
papers.authors: Ziyuan Wang, Fredrik D. Johansson
papers.evidence: 从合成先验分布元学习实现表格上下文预测
papers.tldr: 传统决策树虽透明可独立部署，但每个新任务都要从头训练；表格基础模型能借合成先验做上下文预测，却不产出可单独检查的模型。MotherTree 用表格 Transformer 在合成先验上元学习决策树归纳，单次前向即可为新任务输出硬轴对齐决策树。在受控样本量基准上，它与递归划分、梯度树学习、全局最优树及蒸馏方法尺寸匹配树相当，并稳定优于从头梯度学习。作为强初始化器，任务微调后在所有基准和样本量上均超过对应从头学习器，表明元学习可为小型独立决策树提供有效归纳偏置。
papers.abstract_en: Conventional decision tree algorithms produce effective, transparent models that can be audited, communicated, and deployed independently of the training data, but require learning every new task from scratch. In contrast, tabular foundation models demonstrate that meta-learning from a synthetic prior distribution enables strong in-context prediction for previously unseen tasks, especially in small-sample regimes. However, this approach does not produce a standalone model that can be inspected in isolation. We introduce MotherTree, a tabular transformer that meta-learns decision tree induction: given a training set for a new task, it outputs a hard, axis-aligned decision tree, equivalent in form to classically trained trees, in a single forward pass. MotherTree is pre-trained on a synthetic prior using stochastic gradient descent without requiring reference trees for supervision. On established benchmarks with controlled sample size, the approach is competitive with size-matched trees from common algorithms: recursive partitioning, gradient-based tree learning, globally optimal trees, and distillation from tabular foundation models. Notably, MotherTree consistently improves over from-scratch gradient-based learning and acts as a strong initializer: task-specific tuning of the generated tree outperforms the corresponding from-scratch learner on all benchmarks and sample sizes. These results show that meta-learning can provide effective inductive biases for learning stand-alone, small decision tree classifiers.

papers.title_en: Market Impact Estimation via Causal Foundation Models
papers.authors: Dennis Thumm, Ying Chen
papers.evidence: 在合成市场先验上训练的因果PFN用于摊销估计
papers.tldr: 市场冲击本质是反事实因果量，经典回归把价格回归到订单流，在知情流通过信息渠道同时推动价格时会产生偏差。作者构建连续时间因果PFN市场模拟器，在合成市场先验中以每回合可调的混淆强度训练，并用do消融孪生模型检验干预响应。高混淆下朴素估计最高高估68%，PFN贴近无偏oracle；零样本在ABIDES限价簿及BTC/ETH/SOL与纳斯达克流突增上复现响应。循环状态空间变体把冲击随执行时长累积的形状补足，并将与实测元订单冲击的相关性提升至0.92-0.96，显示该路线用于因果市场冲击估计的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: When a trader executes a large order, the relevant question is not \emph{what will the price be?} but \emph{what would the price have been had I not traded?} Market impact is thus a causal quantity, yet classical models (Almgren--Chriss, propagators) regress price on flow, which is biased whenever informed flow moves prices through information as well as trading. We present a proof-of-concept \emph{Causal Market Simulator}: a continuous-time causal prior-data fitted network (PFN) trained on a synthetic market prior in which a hidden informational flow confounds the flow--price relation by construction, with confounding strength an exact per-episode knob. On this prior, the naive estimator's bias follows a closed form we confirm empirically (up to 68\% overestimation), while the PFN tracks the unbiased true-parameter oracle at high confounding. Its \emph{do-ablated twin}, the same model with the intervention inputs removed, collapses onto the pre-window mean. Zero-shot, the model responds at the ground-truth scale to metaorders in an ABIDES limit-order book ($+0.38$ pre-onset standard deviations against seed-replay counterfactuals), and its intervention response replicates on about 2,300 detected flow bursts in BTC/ETH/SOL perpetuals and 3,800 on Nasdaq equities, evidence consistent with, though not proof of, causal transfer. Off-prior the response degrades gracefully, and split-conformal recalibration repairs interval calibration. Transfer hinges on encoding the metaorder as added flow rather than a clamped price level, not on more training. A recurrent state-space variant closes the remaining shape gap: its impact accrues over execution duration where the transformer's stays flat, raising the correlation with measured metaorder impact from $+0.68$ to between $+0.92$ and $+0.96$, at the cost of weaker on-prior deconfounding that traces to the training recipe rather than to recurrence.

papers.title_en: PDE-PFN: Prior-Data Fitted Neural PDE Solver
papers.authors: Jaehyeon Park, Mingu Kang, Dongseok Lee, Woojin Cho, Kookjin Lee, Anthony Gruber, Youngjoon Hong, Noseong Park
papers.evidence: 用于上下文PDE解预测的先验数据拟合网络
papers.tldr: 针对PDE求解依赖高质量数据且跨方程泛化不足的问题，PDE-PFN将先验数据拟合网络与上下文学习结合，以自注意力和交叉注意力Transformer近似PDE解的后验预测均值。模型用PINN生成的带噪近似解预训练，作为多样但不精确的先验，并在二维PDE上实现零梯度更新的上下文推理。实验显示其可跨异构方程泛化、对噪声先验稳健，预测精度达到或优于基线，并支持灵活的上下文与查询表示。
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the success of large language models (LLMs) with broad generalizability and robustness to noisy or unreliable pre-training data, we explore in-context prediction of PDE solution fields using approximate pre-training data. In addition, inspired by the posterior predictive mean-based inference mechanism of the in-context learning in prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), we propose PDE-PFN, a prior-data fitted neural solver that approximates the posterior predictive mean of PDE solutions via in-context learning. PDE-PFN builds on a PFN architecture with self- and cross-attention mechanisms of Transformer and is pre-trained on noisy approximate solutions generated by physics-informed neural networks, serving as diverse but not necessarily exact priors. Through experiments on a range of two-dimensional PDEs, we demonstrate that PDE-PFN achieves empirical generalization across heterogeneous equations, robustness under noisy priors, and zero-gradient-update in-context inference capability. PDE-PFN achieves competitive or improved predictive accuracy relative to the evaluated baselines while supporting flexible context and query representations.

papers.title_en: Learning Source Structure: Bayesian Prediction with Transformers
papers.authors: Meir Feder, Ruediger Urbanke
papers.evidence: 在源参数不断重抽的序列上预训练，实现基于先验的贝叶斯预测
papers.tldr: 研究源参数每次重抽时，Transformer能否学到源族与先验。作者用可计算的informed Bayes作为可证伪参照，构建最多64符号且跨上下文传递信息的Markov源。结果表明，该参照仅凭源族与先验即可预测训练后模型在四类测试中的行为，如分布外损失2.237对2.309、双分量变化额外损失0.345对0.350。共享结构可见时小模型可逼近参照，隐藏结构需更多层与训练，作者还以注意力统计量与前馈估计器解释其机制。
papers.abstract_en: A transformer trained on sequences whose source parameters are drawn afresh each time can learn only what the sequences share: the source family and its prior. The Bayesian predictor that knows both, which we call informed Bayes, is the unique minimizer of the training loss and is computable from the family alone; we use it as a quantitative, falsifiable reference. Where earlier work compared transformers with Bayes on sources whose contexts can be learned independently, we build Markov sources with up to 64 symbols in which observations in one context inform prediction in another: product sources with known or hidden encodings, transition rows sharing an unknown base law and depth, and a mixture of three families. Our main result is that informed Bayes predicts, from the family and prior alone, how a trained transformer behaves in four tests that go beyond the learning curve: the loss that remains under a source outside the training family (predicted 2.237 bits, measured 2.309), the doubling of the extra loss when two independent components change rather than one (0.345 predicted, 0.350 measured), the benefit of other contexts when a token appears for the first time, and the depth at which copying an earlier continuation starts to pay. On the learning curves themselves, small transformers match informed Bayes when the shared structure is visible in the tokens, and hidden structure needs more layers and training, with gaps below 0.01 bits per token for the largest models. We explain why the imitation is possible and where it must fail: informed Bayes decomposes into sufficient statistics that attention selects and accumulates and an estimator, fixed by the prior, that the feed-forward network learns; training pays the complexity of informed Bayes under the architecture's prior, and finite-memory universal prediction bounds how closely a bounded network can reach it.

papers.title_en: OrionMoE-v1.0: A Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Tabular In-Context Learning
papers.authors: Mohamed Bouadi, Nassim Bouarour, Aditya Tanna, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu
papers.evidence: 面向表格上下文预测的紧凑表格基础模型
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型希望用支持表进行上下文学习，但现有方法多为稠密架构，难以按特征和数据集自适应分配计算。OrionMoE-Small-v1.0 结合分布感知表示与数据集条件稀疏混合专家，基于双轴 Transformer 并由单元格表示和数据集上下文共同路由专家。模型仅用结构化因果先验生成的合成分类任务预训练，下游无需梯度适配。多个表格基准上可媲美更大模型，在小上下文和高维数据上表现突出，并在类别不平衡下展现优势。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates. Despite recent advances, most existing approaches rely on dense architectures that apply the same transformations across features and datasets. We introduce OrionMoE-Small-v1.0, a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation. Built on a dual-axis transformer architecture, OrionMoE-Small selectively activates experts with routing decisions informed by both individual cell representations and the broader dataset context. This design enables adaptive allocation of computation across heterogeneous tabular problems while retaining a shared computational pathway across tasks. The model is pretrained entirely on synthetic classification tasks generated from a structured causal prior and performs downstream prediction without gradient-based adaptation. Experiments across multiple tabular benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against substantially larger foundation models, with particularly strong results on small-context and high-dimensional datasets. Further analysis reveals favorable relative performance under class imbalance and highlights the importance of feature composition.

papers.title_en: Anisotropic Trust Region Warping for Prior-Data Fitted Networks in Bayesian Optimisation
papers.authors: Samuel Younger, Tinkle Chugh, George De Ath
papers.evidence: 通过输入扭曲校正贝叶斯优化中PFN的先验失配
papers.tldr: PFN在贝叶斯优化中可免去GP代理模型反复拟合超参数，但其先验在元训练时固定，目标函数长度尺度偏离先验模式时预测与优化会变差。为此提出各向异性信赖域扭曲（ATR）：用核目标对齐估计逐维长度尺度，并对输入空间做仿射重缩放，使目标匹配PFN预期尺度，同时以锚点周围信赖域筛选观测。该方法无需重训练网络且不增加O(d·N^2)推理成本，在Matérn-3/2函数长度尺度两端均提升PFN优化表现。
papers.abstract_en: Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) replace the hyperparameter refitting of Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates in Bayesian optimisation with a single forward pass, at the cost of a prior that is fixed at meta-training time. We show empirically that a PFN's predictive log-likelihood falls increasingly behind that of a refitted GP as the objective function's lengthscale grows beyond the mode of the PFN's meta-training prior, and that this deficit carries over to optimisation performance. To correct the mismatch without retraining the network, we introduce Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping. Per-dimension lengthscales are estimated by kernel target alignment, and an affine rescaling of the input space maps the objective onto the lengthscale the PFN expects, with a trust region around the anchor determining which observations are retained, leaving the PFN's $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot N^2)$ inference cost unchanged. On functions drawn from a Matérn-3/2 kernel, ATR warping improves optimisation performance of the PFN at both extremes of the lengthscale range. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/Trust-Region-Warping-For-PFNs.

papers.title_en: Tabular Foundation Models Dramatically Outperform Bespoke Photometric Redshift Estimators
papers.authors: Biprateep Dey, Joshua S. Speagle
papers.evidence: 表格基础模型以合成先验预训练并通过上下文学习做表格预测
papers.tldr: 测光红移是星系距离估计与宇宙学研究的核心任务，但数据驱动方法依赖稀缺且有选择偏差的光谱训练集。本文利用表格基础模型（TFM）的上下文学习能力，直接在一次前向传播中预测完整概率分布。在常用基准上，TFM仅用1000个上下文样本就匹配或超过用逾4万个星系训练的传统估计器，并在校准数据稀缺时优势最大。该工作为仅成像巡天提供了样本高效、可缓解选择偏差的新框架。
papers.abstract_en: Estimating galaxy redshifts (a proxy for distance) from imaging data alone, also known as photometric redshifts (photo-$z$'s), is essential for studies of extragalactic astrophysics and cosmology. However, data-driven estimators rely on spectroscopic training datasets, which are scarce and systematically biased toward bright and easily observed galaxies. In this work, we show that tabular foundation models (TFMs), whose synthetic pretraining amounts to a learned prior over regression problems, can outperform bespoke estimators using only in-context learning. Evaluating on a widely used benchmark dataset, we find that TFMs predicting full probability distributions in a single forward pass systematically outperform bespoke estimators across both representative and biased training data regimes, matching or exceeding baselines trained on over $40{,}000$ galaxies with just $1{,}000$ training context examples. We also show that the TFM advantage is largest when little to no calibration data are available, and that it persists even when the bespoke baselines are supplemented with up to $10{,}000$ representative calibration spectra. This shows that TFMs offer a sample-efficient framework for upcoming imaging-only astronomical surveys, where observational selection bias can be mitigated simply by including a small representative calibration sample in context.

papers.title_en: Interpretable by Design Tabular Prediction via In-Context Local Linear Learning
papers.authors: Ran Eisenberg, Steven Berger, Ofir Lindenbaum
papers.evidence: 由表格基础模型引导的表格上下文预测
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型虽能免训练取得高预测精度，但其特征贡献难以解释，事后归因还可能失真。TICL^3 用基础模型引导线性预测：先学数据集级共享线性模型，再按查询检索相似样本并对残差拟合局部线性模型。合并系数直接给出每个特征对查询预测的贡献，实现预测与解释同源。在386个分类基准评估中，它仅落后TabICLv2 1.1个百分点，并优于CatBoost和MAPLE。
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) lets tabular foundation models make predictions without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. These models achieve strong predictive accuracy, but interpreting how individual features contribute to the prediction remains difficult. In biology, for example, feature contributions can help identify biomarkers or risk genes. Post-hoc interpretability methods assign feature importance scores, but these scores do not indicate what the model actually uses and can lead to explanation errors. We introduce TICL$^3$ (Tabular In-Context Local Linear Learning), an interpretable-by-design predictor that uses a tabular foundation model to guide a simple linear prediction rule. TICL$^3$ first learns a shared linear model to capture dataset-level feature effects. Then, for each query, it retrieves similar training samples using representations from the foundation model and fits a second linear model to the residuals in that neighborhood. The shared model captures broad effects, while the local model corrects errors among similar samples. Their combined coefficients determine each feature contribution to the final query-specific linear score, so the same model makes and explains the prediction. Across 386 classification benchmark-dataset evaluations, TICL$^3$ trails TabICLv2 by 1.1 percentage points and outperforms CatBoost in 266 evaluations. It improves average support F1 over MAPLE by 4.7 points and achieves the best performance on both real-data selected-feature utility metrics.
